title: thelypteris × altissima
intro: Thelypteris × altissima, commonly known as the Altissima fern, is a hybrid plant species in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving antioxidant defenses, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Thelypteris × altissima are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit anti-anxiety and anti-depressant effects. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
